ChartField Request Form (CFR)
Creating a New Unrestricted Project
Projects should have both a and a . To create a project, the department requester submits a Project ChartField Request in ARC, and the request is reviewed and approved by the Dean’s Office.
∞
Project Life Budget
The overall budget provided for the full life of the project.
FY
Fiscal Year Budget
The amount the project is estimated to spend during a specific fiscal year.
ARC
Department Request
The department requester submits the CFR in ARC with the required project details.
✓
Dean’s Office Approval
The request is reviewed and approved by the Dean’s Office before activation.
Step 1 of 9
Go to ARC
1
Navigate to my.columbia.edu and click "Go to ARC"
Select ARC from the top navigation bar on my.columbia.edu. On the ARC Portal homepage, click the "Go to ARC" button - highlighted with a red box in the screenshot below.
my.columbia.edu → ARC → Go to ARC
ARC PORTAL - WELCOME PAGESTEP 1
Step 2 of 9
Select the Chartfields Tile
2
Click the Chartfields tile on the ARC homepage
The ARC homepage shows 9 tiles. Click Chartfields - second row, left column, highlighted with a red box.
ARC HOMEPAGE - 9 TILESSTEP 2
Step 3 of 9
Chartfields Home Page
3
Click "Chartfields Request" in the sidebar
The Chartfields sidebar appears with four options. Click Chartfields Request to begin. The Chartfield Values list on the right shows all available types. Click any pill below for more detail on each sidebar option.
CHARTFIELDS HOME - SIDEBARSTEP 3
Step 4 of 9
Select "Project"
4
Click "Project" from the Chartfield Values list
From the Chartfield Values list, click Project. It highlights in orange with a dashed border as shown. Click any pill below for the full definition of each ChartField type.
CHARTFIELD VALUES - PROJECT SELECTEDSTEP 4
Step 5 of 9
Click "Add"
5
On the Project ChartField Request search page, click Add
The Request ID auto-fills as NEXT - the system assigns the number automatically. Click Add (highlighted with red box) to start a fresh request. Use Find an Existing Value on the right to look up and update an existing ChartField.
Chartfields Request → Project → Add a New Value → Add
PROJECT CHARTFIELD REQUEST - ADD BUTTON HIGHLIGHTEDSTEP 5

The main data entry form - required fields marked ✶

Enter project details before selecting Central
After selecting Project Type, fill in the following fields on the form before proceeding to the Central lookup:

Step 7 of 9
Project Team & Activity
7
Add team members and project activities
Scroll down to the Project Team section. Enter the Employee ID (UNI) and select the Project Role using the lookup. Add Project Activity details by clicking the Activity Attribute link. Click pills for full definitions.
PROJECT ROLE LOOKUP - 18 ROLESSTEP 7
↗
Activity Detail - Rate Base and Owning Department
Click Activity Attribute to open the Activity Detail modal. Set Owning Department and Rate Base. Rate Base determines how F&A indirect cost is calculated.
ACTIVITY DETAIL MODALSTEP 7
RATE BASE LOOKUP - 9 OPTIONSSTEP 7
OWNING DEPARTMENT LOOKUP - ENG DEPARTMENTSSTEP 7
Steps 8–9 of 9
Justification, Attachments & Submit
8
Fill in Request Justification, add Department Approver, attach documents, then Submit
Scroll to the bottom of the form. Complete all required fields before hitting Submit. The request will route to your Department Approver, then to Central Finance for activation.
BOTTOM OF FORM - SUBMIT BUTTONSSTEP 8
After You Hit Submit
Request routes: Department Approver → Central Finance → activation. You will receive email notifications at each stage. Track status under Chartfield Request → Find Existing Value. Standard turnaround: 2 to 5 business days for straightforward requests.
